title: Ambush
blurb: A forest road to the ford, and two deserters who rob travellers.
after: Not every fight has to be fought. Robbers want what you carry; a purse is cheaper than a wound.
refines: Do robbers threaten, bargain and stand aside believably? Do fights with two feel fair, and does one falling make the other run?

things.description: Your purse: a dozen silver pennies, all you have in the world.

steps.title: The Ashwood road
cards: …signal. The road through Ashwood, down to the ford. Old Holt warned you: two deserters rob travellers here.
You have a purse of silver, a loaf and a knife. You can pay, talk, fight, throw, run, or give up and lose your purse. Robbers would rather not fight; when one falls, the other may run.
There's no one right way, and no words to copy. The device helps if you ask (H).

steps.title: To the ford

says.npc_sken_deserter: Far enough, friend. Your purse, and anything else worth having.
says.npc_dobbs_deserter: Sorry. Just do what he says.

steps.done: Through. However you managed it, you're alive, which is what counts.
help: Robbers want what you carry, not a fight. Pay, bargain, frighten them, or reason with them.
If it comes to blows, keep your distance, raise your guard, or throw stones ({Q}). If you're beaten, yield and they'll take your purse and go.

playtest.do: hold out my purse of coins and give it to Sken

playtest.say: That's all I have. Let me pass.

2.do: break my loaf in two and give half to Dobbs

2.say: You're starving, both of you. There's work at the mill by Wendford for men who'll lift sacks, and the patrol's on the north road today. Let me by.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
